title: Multi-Activity Calorie Burn Calculator
subtitle: Select several activities, enter minutes for each, and get a combined estimate with a breakdown.
seoTitle: Calorie Burn Calculator by Activity | DailyLogic
seoDescription: Free multi-activity calorie burn calculator: pick running, walking, strength, swimming and more, add minutes for each, and see a combined total with a clear breakdown.
heroDescription: Mixed session? Check everything you did, add minutes, and see total calories burned — plus a per-activity split.

sections.heading: What this calculator does
paragraphs: Enter weight, age, and sex for a more personal estimate.
Select several activities and set a duration for each.
Get an estimated calorie total, a breakdown, and short routine tips.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Fill in your basics, pick activities, enter minutes, then calculate.
Save to history or download a result card.
Treat the numbers as a compass — not a medical reading.

sections.heading: Important
paragraphs: This tool is for inspiration only and does not replace medical or nutrition advice.
Calculations use common MET values — an estimate, not a lab measurement.

benefits.title: Multi-select
benefits.description: Several activities in one session — no need to calculate each alone.

benefits.title: Clear breakdown
benefits.description: See how much each activity contributed to the total.

benefits.title: Practical tips
benefits.description: Small ideas for smarter weekly mix.

faq.question: Is this as accurate as a heart-rate monitor?
faq.answer: No. It’s a MET-and-weight estimate — useful for planning, not a personal measurement.

faq.question: Can I combine activities?
faq.answer: Yes. That’s the point — a combined total with a per-activity split.
